smells.finding: Every function is short and single-purpose (_axis_recomposition, _axis_structure, _corner_verdict ~10-20 lines each); run_gate composes named helpers.
Only tiny frozen dataclasses (AxisRecomposition/AxisStructure/GateResult) as value objects; no god-class.

MINOR observation: _fit_train_delta and _resolved_delta_frame both run estimate_driver_utility(train_rows) then apply the identical resolved-filter predicate est[(status=='resolved') & delta.notna()]; run_gate consequently fits G2 twice on the same train frame (once per limb) and splits twice. Correct, but a small resolved-filter/refit duplication that could be factored. Not a blocker on a synthetic-only harness.
Helpers operate on their own passed frames/maps; no reaching into another object's internals.
(train_rounds, heldout_rounds) travel together but form a natural split pair, not an incidental clump warranting an object.

override.repo_standard: engine-config rules_root + repo convention: physics/analysis code is numeric — pandas DataFrame + numpy ndarray with string axis labels and float deltas are the established boundary types across src/physics.
override.reason: String axes and float deltas are the idiomatic house style for this numeric layer (matches G1/G2 schema); wrapping them in bespoke value types would diverge from the surrounding code, not improve it — the smell is subordinate to the documented numeric-data convention.

smells.finding: Public functions take at most (rows_df, train_rounds, heldout_rounds); dataclass constructors are keyword value objects.
Self-contained new module; a change here does not ripple across many files.
Module has one reason to change (the held-out gate definition).
No long a.b().c().d() chains; pandas groupby idioms are single-hop.

rank_drivers_by_corner_delta (optional reputation) and oos_replication_strength are both concretely required — the handoff mandates a non-gating reputational read and the leakage self-test consumes oos_replication_strength. No unused hooks.

Comments explain genuinely subtle invariants (centering translation-invariance, the calibration-confounded negative control, unresolved->delta=0 falls back to baseline) — they earn their place rather than mask unclear code.
